goals.title: The shape companion — a browser surface for shape sessions

why.text: Adapted from Superpowers' visual companion, widened from visual-design questions to exploring alternatives generally. A conversation surface: it shows things that do not exist yet to help the operator decide. Never a state surface — ledger browsing, runs, and reports stay native-app territory.

doneWhen: a shape session can push screens to the operator's browser and read back clicks with nothing but the skill vendored in this repo
the companion is a client of the quirks daemon (same port, same 0600 token) and can sit side-by-side with the native app
